# CIDEX 2024 — 深圳兴世博科技有限公司 (Shenzhen Ciexpo Environmental Protection Engineering Co., Ltd) — booth 4053

## Ringkasan

兴世博，2009 年创立于深圳，在东莞、苏州、成都、青岛等多地设有办事处，专做各种： 锡渣、电路板、电子呆料和各种含金银铂钯铑铱钽铟等二次物料的回收等的回收 / 加工 / 销售。 Founded in Shenzhen in 2009, Xingshibo has set up offices in Dongguan, Suzhou, Chengdu, Qingdao and other places, specializing in the recycling/processing/sales of various tin dross, circuit boards, electronic waste materials and various secondary materials containing gold, silver, platinum, palladium, rhodium, iridium, tantalum and indium.
